checks.title: speakers
checks.instructions: turn the volume to about half, then play the left, right and both tones.
checks.expect: left only from the left speaker, right only from the right, both from both, with no crackle

checks.title: microphone
checks.instructions: start the microphone and speak, then record 3 s and listen to it played back.
checks.expect: the bar moves when you speak and the recording is clear

checks.title: headphone jack
checks.instructions: plug wired headphones into the jack and play the tones again.
checks.expect: the sound moves to the headphones when they're plugged in and back to the speakers when they're not

checks.title: camera
checks.instructions: start the camera. if there is a second camera, switch to it too.
checks.expect: a live, clear picture from each camera

checks.title: touchscreen
checks.instructions: drag the box to the target with a finger, then rest several fingers on the grey area.
checks.expect: the box follows your finger and at least 5 touches are counted

checks.title: pen
checks.instructions: draw on the pad with the pen, lightly and then hard, and tilt it.
checks.expect: lines get thicker as you press harder and the tilt numbers change

checks.title: keyboard
checks.instructions: press every key, including the function row and the arrows. try the volume and brightness keys too.
checks.expect: every key shows up; volume and brightness change on screen

checks.title: touchpad
checks.instructions: move the pointer, tap to click, scroll with two fingers and right-click.

checks.title: tablet mode
checks.instructions: fold the screen all the way back into tablet mode, then open it back to a laptop.
checks.expect: tablet mode turns on when folded and off when opened; the keyboard stops typing while folded

checks.title: screen rotation
checks.instructions: in tablet mode, turn the machine onto each side and upside down.
checks.expect: the orientation follows the machine and the screen turns with it

checks.title: charger
checks.instructions: unplug the charger, wait a few seconds, then plug it back in.
checks.expect: it goes on battery when unplugged and back to mains, charging, when plugged in

checks.title: lid
checks.instructions: close the lid for a few seconds, then open it. if the machine sleeps, wake it.
checks.expect: the lid is seen closed then open, and the screen comes back

checks.title: external display
checks.instructions: plug in an external display (usb-c or hdmi).
checks.expect: the display is seen as connected and shows a picture

checks.title: bluetooth
checks.instructions: connect a bluetooth device (headphones or a mouse) from the system's bluetooth settings.
checks.expect: the device shows as connected and works

checks.title: wifi
checks.instructions: look at the network icon in the panel.
checks.expect: wifi is connected with a good signal

checks.title: hibernate
checks.instructions: this runs last. the machine hibernates and powers off; turn it back on with the power button.
checks.expect: it comes back where it left off, with this page still open
